name: Amnesia Haze
summary: Amnesia Haze is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] whose origin is disputed. Soma's Sacred Seeds claims to have bred it from Southeast Asian landraces, Jamaican Haze lines, and an Afghani-Hawaiian cross; Leafly instead describes it simply as [[haze|Haze]] crossed with [[afghani|Afghani]]. An entry linked to Soma won the overall High Times Cannabis Cup in 2004, and Soma's own line won the sativa category in 2012.

sources.title: Amnesia Haze
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms Soma's claimed genetics (Southeast Asian lines including Thai/Cambodian/Laotian, Jamaican Haze, and an Afghani-Hawaiian cross).
